title: Chicken Civ building concepts
status: Original generated concept art for user review, not accepted designs or runtime assets.

sourceReference.role: User-supplied tree-village reference, style and architectural direction only.

outputs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original Chicken Civ architectural concept sheet, first of a coherent art set. This is concept art, not a game screenshot.
Primary request: Four lavishly crafted, distinct chicken-built buildings in a 2 by 2 architectural concept sheet. Landscape 3:2 format, four large equally weighted vignettes separated by generous warm ivory negative space. Small elegant dark brown labels only: "BOUGHHOME", "SECOND SUPPER", "KNOTYARD", "ROOT NURSERY". No extra text.
Input image: supplied tree-village reference is the target for painterly craft, organic living wood, rich natural textures, warm sunlight and believable chicken scale. Create entirely new buildings, not a copy of its composition.
Style: premium hand-painted fantasy strategy game concept art, sculptural dimensional forms, expressive irregular silhouettes, intricate but intentional craftsmanship. Golden ochre, moss olive, warm cream, weathered honey timber, cool blue-green shadows. Soft physically believable contact shadows, painterly leaves, rough bark and tight reed weaving. Gorgeous, tangible, inhabited, not low-poly toy render or generic medieval village.
Upper left BOUGHHOME: around the open fork of one thick twisting live bough, a shallow oval timber-and-woven terrace supported by that fork, two low sleeping alcoves under separate curved folded-wing reed rainhoods, open central porch, twig rail, small personal reed sleeping mats, crooked gripping ladder attached visibly to floor. Large exposed organic tree structure, never a box-house glued to a trunk. One cream hen and one russet rooster, anatomically chickens with wings and feet, comfortably at home, floor large enough for them to turn. Bird height approximately one-quarter roof height. Host branch continues out of vignette.
Upper right SECOND SUPPER: a modest low raised depot beside a root buttress: three fat plaited basket silos beneath one arcing reed awning, one shows grain seed, another is dark and lidded for protein food, separate small grey stone ammunition tray; low receiving porch, side carrier lane, fitted packs hanging on pegs. A hen checking one actual carried supply basket and a rooster arriving. Low accessible ramp. Strong three-basket silhouette; no produce spilling decoratively everywhere.
Lower left KNOTYARD: open-air artisan courtyard nestled beside a root, two crooked forked supports hold a horizontal tension-and-weaving jig, broad fan of woven shield panels, a half-finished carry pack on a low jig, oversized cord lashings and neat reed stock. A hen pins a strand with a foot and pulls it with her beak; a rooster braces a lightweight workpiece. No human hands, human workbenches, hammer grasped by wing, furnace or chimney. The canopy is a narrow side awning, most workspace open and visible.
Lower right ROOT NURSERY: a sheltered ground-level hollow BETWEEN roots without cutting the live tree, low crescent woven rainhood enclosing a warm nest and visible small chick at same ground level, broad threshold and sheltered forecourt for grounded young; modest food baskets placed separately, one adult rooster bringing food while an adult hen rests nearby. No eggs used as goods, no cage, no hatchery machine, no elevated baby basket. Open entry facing viewer.
Composition: each vignette has own grounded root/soil patch with restrained moss and small stones, three-quarter elevated strategy angle at same relative chicken scale. Architectural readability first, rich lived-in detail second. Buildings occupy most of each quadrant. No complete giant tree needed on this sheet. Show visible structural supports, useful openings, realistic turning room and low perches. No humans, tools with hand grips, medieval steeples, doors with human knobs, barns, brick chimneys, paved roads, floating platforms, giant decorative eggs, weapons, UI, watermark.
outputs.postProcessing: None; original generated PNG copied byte-for-byte.

outputs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Chicken Civ hero environment concept painting. A richly inhabited living tree settlement, original architecture concept, not an actual game screenshot.
Primary request: create an exceptionally beautiful painterly scene of a chicken civilization around ONE monumental ancient spreading tree. Landscape 3:2. It must feel as warm, textured, physically crafted and organic as reference image 1, while using the distinctive building family from reference image 2. The tree is the protagonist; its immense twisting bifurcated trunk and open forks remain strongly visible. Entire spreading crown and root base fit inside the frame with breathing room, treetop not cropped. Elevated three-quarter strategy camera, around 32 degrees downward, gentle perspective, no fisheye.
Composition: large irregular golden-olive crown occupies upper half, dramatic thick twisting trunk rises in center-left. Three staggered curved terraces nestle in separate real supported forks, not stacked concentric rings. Lowest inhabited terrace is broad and open to viewer, with two modest folded-wing woven reed rainhoods framing an open communal porch and twig rail; middle terrace smaller, a single rainhood and personal mats; upper terrace mostly open as a lookout. Every platform visibly supported by living boughs, fitted timber braces and lashings. Preserve a wide clear window through foliage so these structures and chickens are legible. One hanging woven cargo basket in a clear vertical shaft beside the trunk, genuinely attached to rope and overhead support. Crooked gripping ladders join usable landings, no ladder ending in air. A modest short branch walk reaches a neighboring small tree at right, with supported ends, never crosses the entire landscape.
Ground architecture: at left root buttress the Second Supper depot with three large woven storage baskets and low receiving ramp; at right roots an open Knotyard with forked tension jig, neatly bundled reeds, half-woven carry harness; in lower-left foreground a quiet Wingrest recovery shelter with two shallow wing-shaped woven hoods, ground-level beds and wide open forecourt, an adult rooster resting while a hen and another rooster bring supplies. Farther left tucked between roots a small ground-level nursery with caregiver and one chick, distinct from the adult recovery beds. Keep an open earthen court between buildings and landing, enough room for loaded carriers. To the far right beyond the main tree a small roofless horseshoe practice court with two adult birds, suggesting preparation for an expedition; do not crowd the central home with weapons.
People: around twelve total genuine anatomically recognizable chickens, cream hens, russet hens and roosters, one dark hen inspecting outgoing supply baskets, no humanoid hands or clothes. They have purpose: carrying small body-fitted panniers, weaving using foot and beak, watching, returning home, resting. Keep consistent adult height about 1/17 of tree height, readable cream and rust silhouettes against darker wood. Nobody in an elevated baby basket. No glowing icons or labels.
Story and atmosphere: late golden afternoon, gentle cool blue-green woodland depth, warm sunlight catches feather edges, textured bark and reed fibers. The place is preparing to send an expedition but its home life continues. Lush moss, irregular rocks settled in the soil, subtle short grass, a clear naturally worn footpath and a quiet creek edge in lower right, no paved roads. Hand-painted material richness, rough amber wood, weathered grey bark creases, leaf clusters with small varied shapes, grounded contact shadows, restrained atmospheric haze. Beautiful mature fantasy game environment, handcrafted and full of meaningful detail rather than clutter.
Avoid: human medieval village, barns, chimneys, castle battlements, oversized banners, giant eggs, harvested host trees, circular floating treehouse rings, identical roof modules everywhere, smooth pipe trunks, low-poly blobs, glossy plastic, excessive bloom, shallow-focus miniature photography, photoreal humans, text, UI and watermark. The building forms should be original and fitted to the living tree.

outputs.prompt:
Use case: compositing.
Asset type: Chicken Civ whole-grove architectural overview concept, a companion to the supplied close composition.
Primary request: recompose the supplied scene into a wider, pulled-back overview that shows the ENTIRE ancient tree, its COMPLETE crown including the highest leaves, all its root base, and a margin of sky and woodland around every outer edge. Keep the beautiful painterly material craft and the identity of the actual buildings. This is a deliberate camera pullback and upward expansion, not another crop of the trunk. Landscape 3:2. Main tree crown must end at least 8 percent below the top edge and 6 percent inside both side edges. Let the whole main tree occupy about 82 percent of image height. Include a complete asymmetric spreading oak-like crown in the upper half, strong trunk and three inhabited branch terraces in the middle, readable ground workshops and care buildings in the lower third.
Preserve the distinct two-hood Boughhome and shared porch on the lowest branch, one modest middle shelter, high open watch terrace, side canopy bridge to a smaller tree, ground three-basket supply depot, open forked weaving Knotyard, quiet two-bay Wingrest and ground-level nursery. Keep their structural supports, visible access ladders and hanging cargo basket. Ground approach remains open, heavy stores remain grounded. Do not add buildings just to fill foliage. Whole trees with generous crown windows, no stacking circular rings.
Chickens must stay anatomically chickens and be consistent in scale, about 0.75 m adult height to about 13 m tree height. Around twelve adults with genuine activity, both hens and roosters in work and public roles. Replace any upholstered human-style beds or pillows with woven grass mats and loosely bundled dry reed bolsters. Keep the restrained golden ochre/olive/cream/honey wood palette, cool distant blue-green forest, soft warm side light, intricate irregular bark, delicate leaf clusters, lush moss and creek bank. High-end painterly fantasy strategy environment. Architecture is the subject, not giant portraits of chickens.
Avoid any cropped treetop, cropped crown edges, floating platforms, unnaturally symmetrical canopy, blank upper sky replacing tree crown, forced miniature depth-of-field, human buildings, castles, chimneys, text, interface, labels or watermarks. This image complements a detailed close-up; prioritize the whole-tree silhouette and spatial hierarchy.
